The other checks pass: the label photo is legible and shows model P1410, which is recalled; the serial number SN30006718 is present on the label; the retailer www.amazon.com is listed; and the 2019-09-28 purchase date is inside the sale window. No destruction photo is required. The refund of $87.54 is under the $100 review threshold, so the flag rests on the duplicate match alone.
